scanTargets: Owner-supplied handle and platform for each persona, for the scan retest. These are the accounts a real DNA scan would run against; every result recorded so far used hand-written fixture knowledge instead, so nothing here has been scanned yet.

cohort2.note: SECOND COHORT — SCAN TARGETS, NOT PERSONAS. Everything recorded here is visible on the channel page the owner supplied: handle, platform, subscriber and video counts, bio text, and the format legible in the Shorts grid. There is deliberately NO `knowledge` block for any of them. Cohort 1 carries hand-written positions because those creators are well documented and the fixture was needed to test the WRITER; inventing positions for these five would be the exact defect this work exists to remove — a guess about a person, stored as though observed. Their knowledge must come from a real scan or stay empty.
cohort2.whyTheseFive: They stress what cohort 1 could not. All five are PRODUCT-LED, so they exercise the `product` knowledge kind, `showability`, and the ownership split between reviewing and owning — the axes cohort 1 mostly left idle.

cohort2.answersNote: The `answers` and `truth` blocks are DERIVED FROM OBSERVABLE CHANNEL FACTS, not supplied by the creator. What someone TYPES in onboarding is a handful of closed choices readable off a channel page — do they hold the product on camera, do they sell anything, what do they make. What someone BELIEVES is a claim about their mind. The first is derivable; the second is not, which is why there is still no `knowledge` block here. Where a fact is genuinely unknown it says UNVERIFIED rather than guessing.
cohort2.knowledgeProvenance: EXTRACTED, NOT WRITTEN. These items came from the real extractor reading the real titles legible in the owner-supplied screenshots — six per channel, not a scan. Two of the five produced ZERO and have no knowledge block, which is the correct answer for their input rather than a failure: their on-screen text is burned-in caption fragments ("CAN'T HAVE A", "unlock"), not descriptive titles.

cohort3.$why: The first cohort built from a REAL scan rather than from what an author could remember about a creator. Cohort 1 knowledge is hand-written; cohort 2 has none. This one is the live extractor output over 86 real titles, so a difference in results is a difference in the DATA and not in how carefully somebody typed a fixture.
cohort3.$limits: Titles only — no transcripts, so no opinion-level or experience-level evidence exists for anyone here. Every item is coverage. That is the honest ceiling of a caption-only scan and it is exactly what the comparison should show.
